title: Divorce Cooling-off Period
synopsis: Learn about a new, controversial divorce policy in China. What are your thoughts?

fullText.simplified:
离婚冷静期，良策还是鸡肋？

    “这日子我受够了！离婚！”“离就离！我也受够你了！”这样的话听起来是不是很熟悉？
    人们常说婚姻就是每天都有一万次想杀死对方的冲动，但又一万次选择原谅对方。在婚姻中，从未动过离婚念头的夫妻大概寥寥无几，但大部分人仍然会在冷静后选择继续这段婚姻。然而，随着社会变革，中国越来越多的夫妻在这样的对话后真正付诸行动，选择了离婚。据中国民政部统计，2019年，全中国共有950万对夫妻结婚，而离婚的夫妻则高达400多万对。
    出现如此高的离婚率，主要有以下两点原因。首先是女性经济日益独立，家庭结构正逐渐从男性掌握经济大权转变为双方经济平等。其次是出现越来越多的“双独家庭”，即夫妻双方均为独生子女。由于他们都习惯了独享家庭中全部的关爱，双方往往会更缺乏宽容和耐心，导致了较高比例的“冲动离婚”。
    为了解决这一问题，中国将从2021年1月1日起实施“离婚冷静期”政策。新政一出，就在民间激起轩然大波，各方对这一新政态度迥异。支持者认为，这一新政有助于减少冲动型离婚，避免出现家庭悲剧；反对者则认为从法律层面设置离婚冷静期，是变相地损害婚姻自由，更有激进的观点认为这是婚姻制度的历史性倒退。
    针对这些争议，中国一位民法专家对政策进行了解读。
    在现有的法律条款下，在中国离婚存在两种方式：协议离婚和诉讼离婚。
    协议离婚指的是夫妻双方感情破裂，没有子女抚养权归属和财产分割争议的情况下，夫妻双方都自愿解除婚姻关系的，就可以直接向民政局提出离婚申请。经调解双方仍想离婚的，就可以办理离婚证书，就在法律上完成了离婚程序。这种情况是目前最常见的离婚方式，也是冲动离婚的高发区。前一天晚上吵架第二天就去离婚的夫妻屡见不鲜。而在中国“宁拆十座庙，不毁一桩婚”的文化背景下，民政局的工作人员往往会借口“打印机坏了”，让双方回家冷静一下，经过深思熟虑再做决定。由于手续过于简单，这一制度被不少人诟病为“全世界最简单的离婚流程”。
    而如果夫妻一方执意不离婚、双方存在不可调和的财产分割矛盾或者家暴、婚内出轨等情况，就需要进行诉讼离婚了。想离婚的一方向法院提出离婚申请，请法院进行调解和判决。如果协议离婚失败，也可以申请进行诉讼离婚。一旦选择诉讼离婚，意味着夫妻关系的矛盾已经深化到了不可调和的程度。虽然法官仍然本着劝和不劝离的原则，但大部分夫妻仍然会选择离婚。诉讼离婚的周期较长，往往会持续半年以上。
    新政中增加的离婚冷静期是指在协议离婚的情况下，夫妻双方在提交离婚申请后，经过三十天冷静期，如果仍执意离婚，才能办理离婚证走完离婚程序。期间如果一方反悔，申请撤销离婚申请的，离婚申请自动失效；或者双方未在冷静期结束后申请离婚证书的，离婚申请同样不具备法律效力。而因为家暴、婚内出轨等申请的诉讼离婚中，是没有增设冷静期的。
    事实上，可以把新政理解为由原本的潜规则上升成了明确的法律条款。
    而因为大部分人对离婚相关的法律规定并不了解，才会望文生义误解这一全新的法律条款。尽管事实上，这一法律确实会在客观上提升离婚难度，但到底是能有效挽救婚姻还是只是将离婚过程拖长，在法律真正实施后的统计结果出炉以前，做出任何结论都为时尚早。
fullText.traditional:
離婚冷靜期，良策還是雞肋？

    “這日子我受夠了！離婚！”“離就離！我也受夠你了！”這樣的話聽起來是不是很熟悉？
    人們常說婚姻就是每天都有一萬次想殺死對方的衝動，但又一萬次選擇原諒對方。在婚姻中，從未動過離婚念頭的夫妻大概寥寥無幾，但大部分人仍然會在冷靜後選擇繼續這段婚姻。然而，隨著社會變革，中國越來越多的夫妻在這樣的對話後真正付諸行動，選擇了離婚。據中國民政部統計，2019年，全中國共有950萬對夫妻結婚，而離婚的夫妻則高達400多萬對。
    出現如此高的離婚率，主要有以下兩點原因。首先是女性經濟日益獨立，家庭結構正逐漸從男性掌握經濟大權轉變為雙方經濟平等。其次是出現越來越多的“雙獨家庭”，即夫妻雙方均為獨生子女。由於他們都習慣了獨享家庭中全部的關愛，雙方往往會更缺乏寬容和耐心，導致了較高比例的“衝動離婚”。
    為了解決這一問題，中國將從2021年1月1日起實施“離婚冷靜期”政策。新政一出，就在民間激起軒然大波，各方對這一新政態度迥異。支持者認為，這一新政有助於減少衝動型離婚，避免出現家庭悲劇；反對者則認為從法律層面設置離婚冷靜期，是變相地損害婚姻自由，更有激進的觀點認為這是婚姻制度的歷史性倒退。
    針對這些爭議，中國一位民法專家對政策進行了解讀。
    在現有的法律條款下，在中國離婚存在兩種方式：協議離婚和訴訟離婚。
    協議離婚指的是夫妻雙方感情破裂，沒有子女撫養權歸屬和財產分割爭議的情況下，夫妻雙方都自願解除婚姻關係的，就可以直接向民政局提出離婚申請。經調解雙方仍想離婚的，就可以辦理離婚證書，就在法律上完成了離婚程序。這種情況是目前最常見的離婚方式，也是衝動離婚的高發區。前一天晚上吵架第二天就去離婚的夫妻屢見不鮮。而在中國“寧拆十座廟，不毀一樁婚”的文化背景下，民政局的工作人員往往會借口“打印機壞了”，讓雙方回家冷靜一下，經過深思熟慮再做決定。由於手續過於簡單，這一制度被不少人詬病為“全世界最簡單的離婚流程”。
    而如果夫妻一方執意不離婚、雙方存在不可調和的財產分割矛盾或者家暴、婚內出軌等情況，就需要進行訴訟離婚了。想離婚的一方向法院提出離婚申請，請法院進行調解和判決。如果協議離婚失敗，也可以申請進行訴訟離婚。一旦選擇訴訟離婚，意味著夫妻關係的矛盾已經深化到了不可調和的程度。雖然法官仍然本著勸和不勸離的原則，但大部分夫妻仍然會選擇離婚。訴訟離婚的週期較長，往往會持續半年以上。
    新政中增加的離婚冷靜期是指在協議離婚的情況下，夫妻雙方在提交離婚申請後，經過三十天冷靜期，如果仍執意離婚，才能辦理離婚證走完離婚程序。期間如果一方反悔，申請撤銷離婚申請的，離婚申請自動失效；或者雙方未在冷靜期結束後申請離婚證書的，離婚申請同樣不具備法律效力。而因為家暴、婚內出軌等申請的訴訟離婚中，是沒有增設冷靜期的。
    事實上，可以把新政理解為由原本的潛規則上昇成了明確的法律條款。
    而因為大部分人對離婚相關的法律規定並不瞭解，才會望文生義誤解這一全新的法律條款。儘管事實上，這一法律確實會在客觀上提昇離婚難度，但到底是能有效挽救婚姻還是只是將離婚過程拖長，在法律真正實施後的統計結果出爐以前，做出任何結論都為時尚早。

sentences.traditional: 沒有子女撫養權歸屬和財產分割爭議的情況下，
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu zǐ nǚ fǔ yǎng quán guī shǔ hé cái chǎn fēn gē zhēng yì de qíng kuàng xià
sentences.english: Uncontested divorce is when there is a breakdown in the relationship, ..

sentences.simplified: 夫妻双方都自愿解除婚姻关系的，
sentences.traditional: 夫妻雙方都自願解除婚姻關係的，
sentences.pinyin: fū qī shuāng fāng dōu zì yuàn jiě chú hūn yīn guān xi de
sentences.english: .. and in the case where there no are disputes over child custody or property division, ..

sentences.simplified: 就可以直接向民政局提出离婚申请。
sentences.traditional: 就可以直接向民政局提出離婚申請。
sentences.pinyin: jiù kě yǐ zhí jiē xiàng mín zhèng jú tí chū lí hūn shēn qǐng
sentences.english: .. and both parties are willing to dissolve the marriage.

sentences.simplified: 经调解双方仍想离婚的，就可以办理离婚证书，
sentences.traditional: 經調解雙方仍想離婚的，就可以辦理離婚證書，
sentences.pinyin: jīng tiáo jiě shuāng fāng réng xiǎng lí hūn de jiù kě yǐ bàn lǐ lí hūn zhèng shū
sentences.english: In this case, the parties can directly file for divorce at the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

sentences.simplified: 就在法律上完成了离婚程序。
sentences.traditional: 就在法律上完成了離婚程序。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài fǎ lǜ shang wán chéng le lí hūn chéng xù
sentences.english: After mediation, if both parties still wish to divorce, ..

sentences.simplified: 这种情况是目前最常见的离婚方式，
sentences.traditional: 這種情況是目前最常見的離婚方式，
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng shì mù qián zuì cháng jiàn de lí hūn fāng shì
sentences.english: .. they can then obtain a divorce certificate and legally complete the divorce process.

sentences.simplified: 也是冲动离婚的高发区。
sentences.traditional: 也是衝動離婚的高發區。
sentences.pinyin: yě shì chōng dòng lí hūn de gāo fā qū
sentences.english: This situation is currently the most common type of divorce,

sentences.simplified: 前一天晚上吵架第二天就去离婚的夫妻屡见不鲜。
sentences.traditional: 前一天晚上吵架第二天就去離婚的夫妻屢見不鮮。
sentences.pinyin: qián yì tiān wǎn shang chǎo jià dì èr tiān jiù qù lí hūn de fū qī lǚ jiàn bù xiān
sentences.english: .. and is also an area of high occurrence for impulse divorces.

sentences.simplified: 而在中国“宁拆十座庙，不毁一桩婚”的文化背景下，
sentences.traditional: 而在中國“寧拆十座廟，不毀一樁婚”的文化背景下，
sentences.pinyin: ér zài zhōng guó nìng chāi shí zuò miào bù huǐ yì zhuāng hūn de wén huà bèi jǐng xià
sentences.english: Couples who fight one night and file for divorce the next day are all too common.

sentences.simplified: 民政局的工作人员往往会借口“打印机坏了”，
sentences.traditional: 民政局的工作人員往往會借口“打印機壞了”，
sentences.pinyin: mín zhèng jú de gōng zuò rén yuán wǎng wǎng huì jiè kǒu dǎ yìn jī huài le
sentences.english: And with the Chinese cultural background of “Better destroy ten temples than destroy one marriage”, ..

sentences.simplified: 让双方回家冷静一下，经过深思熟虑再做决定。
sentences.traditional: 讓雙方回家冷靜一下，經過深思熟慮再做決定。
sentences.pinyin: ràng shuāng fāng huí jiā lěng jìng yí xià jīng guò shēn sī shú lǜ zài zuò jué dìng
sentences.english: .. employees at the Ministry of Civil Affairs often use excuses such as “the printer is broken”.

sentences.simplified: 由于手续过于简单，
sentences.traditional: 由於手續過於簡單，
sentences.pinyin: yóu yú shǒu xù guò yú jiǎn dān
sentences.english: This is to let both parties go home, calm down, and think everything through before making the decision.

sentences.simplified: 这一制度被不少人诟病为“全世界最简单的离婚流程”。
sentences.traditional: 這一制度被不少人詬病為“全世界最簡單的離婚流程”。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yī zhì dù bèi bù shǎo rén gòu bìng wéi quán shì jiè zuì jiǎn dān de lí hūn liú chéng
sentences.english: Due to the procedure being overly simple, ..
.. this system has been criticized by many as “the world’s easiest divorce process”.

sentences.simplified: 而如果夫妻一方执意不离婚、
sentences.traditional: 而如果夫妻一方執意不離婚、
sentences.pinyin: ér rú guǒ fū qī yì fāng zhí yì bù lí hūn

sentences.simplified: 双方存在不可调和的财产分割矛盾或者家暴、婚内出轨等情况，
sentences.traditional: 雙方存在不可調和的財產分割矛盾或者家暴、婚內出軌等情況，
sentences.pinyin: shuāng fāng cún zài bù kě tiáo hé de cái chǎn fēn gē máo dùn huò zhě jiā bào hūn nèi chū guǐ děng qíng kuàng
sentences.english: Yet in situations such as when one party refuses to divorce, ..

sentences.simplified: 就需要进行诉讼离婚了。
sentences.traditional: 就需要進行訴訟離婚了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù xū yào jìn xíng sù sòng lí hūn le
sentences.english: .. irreconcilable property division issue, or domestic violence or infidelity, ..

sentences.simplified: 想离婚的一方向法院提出离婚申请，请法院进行调解和判决。
sentences.traditional: 想離婚的一方向法院提出離婚申請，請法院進行調解和判決。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng lí hūn de yì fāng xiàng fǎ yuàn tí chū lí hūn shēn qǐng qǐng fǎ yuàn jìn xíng tiáo jiě hé pàn jué
sentences.english: .. they need to go through the process of a contested divorce.

sentences.simplified: 如果协议离婚失败，也可以申请进行诉讼离婚。
sentences.traditional: 如果協議離婚失敗，也可以申請進行訴訟離婚。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ xié yì lí hūn shī bài yě kě yǐ shēn qǐng jìn xíng sù sòng lí hūn
sentences.english: The party that wishes to divorce will file for divorce with the court, and the court will mediate and make a ruling.

sentences.simplified: 一旦选择诉讼离婚，
sentences.traditional: 一旦選擇訴訟離婚，
sentences.pinyin: yí dàn xuǎn zé sù sòng lí hūn
sentences.english: If the uncontested divorce fails, they can also file for contested divorce.

sentences.simplified: 意味着夫妻关系的矛盾已经深化到了不可调和的程度。
sentences.traditional: 意味著夫妻關係的矛盾已經深化到了不可調和的程度。
sentences.pinyin: yì wèi zhe fū qī guān xi de máo dùn yǐ jīng shēn huà dào le bù kě tiáo hé de chéng dù
sentences.english: Once contested divorce is chosen, ..

sentences.simplified: 虽然法官仍然本着劝和不劝离的原则，但大部分夫妻仍然会选择离婚。
sentences.traditional: 雖然法官仍然本著勸和不勸離的原則，但大部分夫妻仍然會選擇離婚。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán fǎ guān réng rán běn zhe quàn hé bú quàn lí de yuán zé dàn dà bù fen fū qī réng rán huì xuǎn zé lí hūn
sentences.english: .. this indicates that the couple’s conflicting views have escalated beyond the point of mediation.

sentences.simplified: 诉讼离婚的周期较长，往往会持续半年以上。
sentences.traditional: 訴訟離婚的週期較長，往往會持續半年以上。
sentences.pinyin: sù sòng lí hūn de zhōu qī jiào cháng wǎng wǎng huì chí xù bàn nián yǐ shàng
sentences.english: Though judges operate on the principle of mediating rather than separating, most couples will still choose to divorce.
Contested divorces have a longer time cycle and will often take half a year or more.

sentences.simplified: 新政中增加的离婚冷静期是指在协议离婚的情况下，
sentences.traditional: 新政中增加的離婚冷靜期是指在協議離婚的情況下，
sentences.pinyin: xīn zhèng zhōng zēng jiā de lí hūn lěng jìng qī shì zhǐ zài xié yì lí hūn de qíng kuàng xià

sentences.simplified: 夫妻双方在提交离婚申请后，经过三十天冷静期，
sentences.traditional: 夫妻雙方在提交離婚申請後，經過三十天冷靜期，
sentences.pinyin: fū qī shuāng fāng zài tí jiāo lí hūn shēn qǐng hòu jīng guò sān shí tiān lěng jìng qī
sentences.english: The new policy of the divorce cooling-off policy refers to an uncontested divorce, ..

sentences.simplified: 如果仍执意离婚，才能办理离婚证走完离婚程序。
sentences.traditional: 如果仍執意離婚，才能辦理離婚證走完離婚程序。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ réng zhí yì lí hūn cái néng bàn lǐ lí hūn zhèng zǒu wán lí hūn chéng xù
sentences.english: .. after both parties file for divorce, they will go through a thirty-day cooling-off period.

sentences.simplified: 期间如果一方反悔，申请撤销离婚申请的，
sentences.traditional: 期間如果一方反悔，申請撤銷離婚申請的，
sentences.pinyin: qī jiān rú guǒ yì fāng fǎn huǐ shēn qǐng chè xiāo lí hūn shēn qǐng de
sentences.english: They can only receive a divorce certificate and complete the divorce procedure if they insist on divorce after the period ends.

sentences.simplified: 离婚申请自动失效；
sentences.traditional: 離婚申請自動失效；
sentences.pinyin: lí hūn shēn qǐng zì dòng shī xiào
sentences.english: During this period if one party has regrets and applies to withdraw their divorce filing, ..

sentences.simplified: 或者双方未在冷静期结束后申请离婚证书的，
sentences.traditional: 或者雙方未在冷靜期結束後申請離婚證書的，
sentences.pinyin: huò zhě shuāng fāng wèi zài lěng jìng qī jié shù hòu shēn qǐng lí hūn zhèng shū de
sentences.english: .. then the divorce filing is automatically invalidated.

sentences.simplified: 离婚申请同样不具备法律效力。
sentences.traditional: 離婚申請同樣不具備法律效力。
sentences.pinyin: lí hūn shēn qǐng tóng yàng bú jù bèi fǎ lǜ xiào lì
sentences.english: Or, if both parties do not apply for their divorce certificate after this period ends, ..

sentences.simplified: 而因为家暴、婚内出轨等申请的诉讼离婚中，是没有增设冷静期的。
sentences.traditional: 而因為家暴、婚內出軌等申請的訴訟離婚中，是沒有增設冷靜期的。
sentences.pinyin: ér yīn wèi jiā bào hūn nèi chū guǐ děng shēn qǐng de sù sòng lí hūn zhōng shì méi yǒu zēng shè lěng jìng qī de
sentences.english: .. their divorce filing similarly will not be legally valid.
Contested divorces filed due to situations such as domestic violence or infidelity do not have this new cooling-off period.

sentences.simplified: 事实上，可以把新政理解为由原本的潜规则上升成了明确的法律条款。
sentences.traditional: 事實上，可以把新政理解為由原本的潛規則上昇成了明確的法律條款。
sentences.pinyin: shì shí shang kě yǐ bǎ xīn zhèng lǐ jiě wéi yóu yuán běn de qián guī zé shàng shēng chéng le míng què de fǎ lǜ tiáo kuǎn

sentences.english: In reality, this new policy can be interpreted as upgrading a pre-existing, unspoken rule into a clearly defined law.

sentences.simplified: 而因为大部分人对离婚相关的法律规定并不了解，
sentences.traditional: 而因為大部分人對離婚相關的法律規定並不瞭解，
sentences.pinyin: ér yīn wèi dà bù fen rén duì lí hūn xiāng guān de fǎ lǜ guī dìng bìng bù liǎo jiě

sentences.simplified: 才会望文生义误解这一全新的法律条款。
sentences.traditional: 才會望文生義誤解這一全新的法律條款。
sentences.pinyin: cái huì wàng wén shēng yì wù jiě zhè yī quán xīn de fǎ lǜ tiáo kuǎn
sentences.english: Most people are not really knowledgeable about laws relating to divorce, ..

sentences.simplified: 尽管事实上，这一法律确实会在客观上提升离婚难度，
sentences.traditional: 儘管事實上，這一法律確實會在客觀上提昇離婚難度，
sentences.pinyin: jǐn guǎn shì shí shang zhè yī fǎ lǜ què shí huì zài kè guān shang tí shēng lí hūn nán dù
sentences.english: .. so they took this law too literally and misunderstood it.

sentences.simplified: 但到底是能有效挽救婚姻还是只是将离婚过程拖长，
sentences.traditional: 但到底是能有效挽救婚姻還是只是將離婚過程拖長，
sentences.pinyin: dàn dào dǐ shì néng yǒu xiào wǎn jiù hūn yīn hái shi zhǐ shì jiāng lí hūn guò chéng tuō cháng
sentences.english: In reality, this law does objectively increase the difficulty of divorce.

sentences.simplified: 在法律真正实施后的统计结果出炉以前，做出任何结论都为时尚早。
sentences.traditional: 在法律真正實施後的統計結果出爐以前，做出任何結論都為時尚早。
sentences.pinyin: zài fǎ lǜ zhēn zhèng shí shī hòu de tǒng jì jié guǒ chū lú yǐ qián zuò chū rèn hé jié lùn dōu wéi shí shàng zǎo
sentences.english: But as to whether it will effectively save marriages or just drag out the divorce process, ..
.. until the law is actually implemented and results are recorded, it’s too early to make any conclusions.

raw.synopsis: Learn about a new, controversial divorce policy in China. What are your thoughts?
sentence_translations: Divorce Cooling-off Period: Good Policy or Ineffective?
“I’ve had enough! Let’s get a divorce!”
“Let’s divorce then! I’ve also had enough of you!” Doesn’t this sound very familiar?
People often say that marriage is having the urge to kill the other person ten thousands times every day, ..
.. yet also choosing to forgive them ten thousand times.
In marriage, couples who have never thought about divorce are far and few between.
But, most people, when they have calmed down, will choose to continue the marriage.
Yet, as society evolves, China is seeing more and more couples who after having this sort of conversation, ..
.. actually take action and choose to divorce.
According to numbers from China’s Ministry of Civil Affairs, in 2019, 9.5 million couples got married in China.
The number of couples getting divorced reached 4 million.
Such a high divorce rate can mostly be attributed to the two reasons below.
First is that women are increasingly gaining economic independence.
Thus, family structure is slowly changing from men having economic power to economic equality between partners.
Next is the emergence of more and more “double only child families”, where both husband and wife are only children.
Because they are accustomed to being the sole recipient of their family’s love and care, ..
.. they both often lack tolerance and patience, causing a high proportion of “impulse divorces”.
In order to solve this problem, China will implement a “divorce cooling-off period” policy beginning January 1, 2021.
As soon as the new policy was announced, it caused an uproar.
There are many different views about this new policy.
Supporters believe that the new policy will help in reducing impulse divorces, avoiding family tragedies.
Opponents believe that from a legal standpoint, a divorce cooling-off period is covertly infringing marriage freedom.
More radical viewpoints see this as historically, a step backwards for the marriage system.
In response to this controversy, a Chinese expert in civil law interpreted this policy.
Under the current law, there are two methods of divorce in China:  uncontested divorce and contested divorce.
Uncontested divorce is when there is a breakdown in the relationship, ..
.. and in the case where there no are disputes over child custody or property division, ..
.. and both parties are willing to dissolve the marriage.
In this case, the parties can directly file for divorce at the Ministry of Civil Affairs.
After mediation, if both parties still wish to divorce, ..
.. they can then obtain a divorce certificate and legally complete the divorce process.
This situation is currently the most common type of divorce,
.. and is also an area of high occurrence for impulse divorces.
Couples who fight one night and file for divorce the next day are all too common.
And with the Chinese cultural background of “Better destroy ten temples than destroy one marriage”, ..
.. employees at the Ministry of Civil Affairs often use excuses such as “the printer is broken”.
This is to let both parties go home, calm down, and think everything through before making the decision.
Due to the procedure being overly simple, ..
.. this system has been criticized by many as “the world’s easiest divorce process”.
Yet in situations such as when one party refuses to divorce, ..
.. irreconcilable property division issue, or domestic violence or infidelity, ..
.. they need to go through the process of a contested divorce.
The party that wishes to divorce will file for divorce with the court, and the court will mediate and make a ruling.
If the uncontested divorce fails, they can also file for contested divorce.
Once contested divorce is chosen, ..
.. this indicates that the couple’s conflicting views have escalated beyond the point of mediation.
Though judges operate on the principle of mediating rather than separating, most couples will still choose to divorce.
Contested divorces have a longer time cycle and will often take half a year or more.
The new policy of the divorce cooling-off policy refers to an uncontested divorce, ..
.. after both parties file for divorce, they will go through a thirty-day cooling-off period.
They can only receive a divorce certificate and complete the divorce procedure if they insist on divorce after the period ends.
During this period if one party has regrets and applies to withdraw their divorce filing, ..
.. then the divorce filing is automatically invalidated.
Or, if both parties do not apply for their divorce certificate after this period ends, ..
.. their divorce filing similarly will not be legally valid.
Contested divorces filed due to situations such as domestic violence or infidelity do not have this new cooling-off period.
In reality, this new policy can be interpreted as upgrading a pre-existing, unspoken rule into a clearly defined law.
Most people are not really knowledgeable about laws relating to divorce, ..
.. so they took this law too literally and misunderstood it.
In reality, this law does objectively increase the difficulty of divorce.
But as to whether it will effectively save marriages or just drag out the divorce process, ..
.. until the law is actually implemented and results are recorded, it’s too early to make any conclusions.
